verdict.rationale: gstack's own /learn skill can review, search, prune and export what it has learned across sessions (gstack-docs-8). Those learnings are stored locally as JSONL, an open format, at ~/.gstack/projects/{slug}/learnings.jsonl (gstack-docs-17). Skills are plain files read from disk, so the core of the story is partly delivered, but only for learnings. Missing for 10: documented export of all gstack data (domain skills, telemetry, settings), a stated export format for /learn, an explicit leave/uninstall path, and independent corroboration.
